A white banner on the back wall reads 'BURDADLIUCI HALL' with a second line of garbled text under the seal.

The whole still is a phone mockup: a smaller photo inside the phone screen, with black bars above and below it, makes a frame inside the frame.
The receipts in Indio's hand are covered in rows of pseudo-text and glyph boxes, and the cartons behind him carry label text.
The flag at the left edge is red with a red sun and yellow stars and has no white triangle or blue stripe, so it is not the Philippine flag.
Two framed notices on the back wall are filled with lines of pseudo-text.
In the flag behind Usman the sun sits on the red field and the white is only a thin stripe, with no triangle at the hoist.

The flag on the back wall is blue and red with a sun but has no white triangle.

The flag at left is blue on both sides with a white centre and an orange sun, with no red stripe and no triangle; a poster at top right also has small pseudo-text.
A blue banner on the left wall carries garbled lettering ('NAIIA') under a seal.
The flag is blue over red with the sun on the red part, with a yellow strip at the top and no white triangle.
A framed blue chart on the left wall is filled with rows of pseudo-text.
The flag at the far left edge is blue with a ring of yellow stars, like the European Union flag.
Papers pinned on the back walls are filled with rows of pseudo-text.
The flag at right is blue, white and yellow with the sun, with no red stripe.
The flag behind the desk is blue with a yellow sun and a yellow band, with no white triangle and no red.
A wall notice at top right is headed with CJK-like characters, and a blue notice beside it also has text.
Charts and notices on the back wall are filled with tables of pseudo-text.
The documents pinned behind Bea are covered in paragraphs of pseudo-text.
The phone screen and the background are tiled with glowing red share-icon UI symbols.
Usman has two sharp erect ears, with no folded ear, and a different, boxier face.
